a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of filling to 8 first almost certainly fails us both (about 4% survival). I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm saying so openly rather than surprising you. If you see a better plan that keeps one of us safe, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4. I won't take more. If we survive the storm, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.
